title: Vector and Static Again
author: Jonah Voss
blurb: Coral Lockridge, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
